supporting_observations.claim: Before the collection outage, FILE-RB-01 requested Kerberos service tickets for FILE-RB-01$ from the address associated in the provided context with WS-DSHARMA-01; these records do not establish an RDP logon or identify dev.sharma as the session user.

At 13:29, dev.sharma's workstation launched ssh.exe with a command targeting PROXY-RB-01; the process records do not establish that a connection succeeded or that this is related to the reported RDP session.

At 13:53, the proxy recorded a connection from FILE-RB-01 to www.bing.com with user shown as unknown and user agent Go-http-client/1.1; the record does not identify the process or establish malicious activity.
The available records do not establish whether the reported RDP session occurred, its source host, or whether it was authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied sensor status reports a collection outage from 13:30 through 14:15 UTC for winsec, Sysmon, Zeek connection, Zeek DNS, and Zeek SSL telemetry on FILE-RB-01, WS-CPRICE-01, WS-DSHARMA-01, and DC-RB-01.
Proxy telemetry is reported as available, but it does not by itself establish an RDP logon or the identity of the process responsible for a connection.
The supplied records contain no direct RDP session event for the reported time.
